formal_statement: ∀ m n : ℕ, 3 ≤ m → PEqualNP.Gct.HasDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → m ^ 2 + 2 ≤ 2 * n
plain_statement: OPEN TARGET, first non-textbook goal of the program: over C, every determinantal expression of perm_m with m >= 3 has size at least m^2/2 + 1, one more than Mignon and Ressayre (IMRN 2004, here L-gct-009). True for m = 3 by Alper, Bogart and Velasco (dc(perm_3) = 7); open in general as far as this seat knows.
title: Beyond Mignon-Ressayre by one: dc(perm_m) >= m^2/2 + 1 for m >= 3
